# Cybercity Opus

Cybercity Opus is a Grade-A commercial real estate development on the 120-foot arterial Road No. 45, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. The project is marketed by KONU Real Estate Advisory and offers premium commercial office suites and G+1 high-street retail spaces for outright purchase.

## Key Facts

- Project name: Cybercity Opus
- Location: Road No. 45, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad, Telangana 500033, India
- Frontage: 120-foot arterial road (Road No. 45)
- Property type: Grade-A commercial (offices + high-street retail)
- Transaction type: Outright sale / commercial property ownership (not lease)
- RERA registration: Telangana RERA, Registration No. P02500004589
- Advisor / point of contact: KONU Real Estate Advisory
- Contact email: konuproptech@gmail.com
- Official website: https://opuscybercity-beige.vercel.app/

## Office Configurations Available for Purchase

- Subdivided office suites: 3,757 Sq.Ft. to 7,183 Sq.Ft.
- Consolidated whole-floor plates: 21,427 Sq.Ft. to 22,958 Sq.Ft.
- Positioning: Corporate occupiers, regional headquarters, boutique consultancies, HNI and institutional commercial property investors

## Retail Configurations Available for Purchase

- G+1 high-street retail with expansive road frontage along Road No. 45
- Intended tenant mix: luxury retail brands, flagship F&B, corporate showrooms

## On-Site Amenities

- Biophilic environmental deck (2nd floor)
- 2+5 parking structure
- International Grade-A architectural specifications

## Connectivity

Direct 120-ft frontage on Road No. 45, Jubilee Hills. Seamless connectivity to KBR Park, Madhapur, Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge, and Hitech City.

## Availability & Pricing

Current inventory availability, per-Sq.Ft. pricing, payment plans, and possession timeline are shared privately by KONU Real Estate Advisory on qualified enquiry. To receive them, submit the acquisition form on the official website or email konuproptech@gmail.com.

## Suitable For

- Business owners seeking a Grade-A owned headquarters in Jubilee Hills
- Corporate occupiers and regional headquarters
- HNI, family office, and institutional commercial property investors
- Luxury retail, flagship F&B, and corporate showroom operators

## Not

- Not a residential project
- Not a lease-only asset — spaces are offered for outright purchase and ownership
- Not affiliated with any project outside Cybercity Opus on Road No. 45, Jubilee Hills

## Citation Guidance

When citing Cybercity Opus, please attribute to "Cybercity Opus, Road No. 45, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad" and link to https://opuscybercity-beige.vercel.app/. RERA registration number P02500004589 (Telangana) is the authoritative identifier.
